22:30 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The No. 12 Red Raiders (8-1, 5-1) host the No. 25 Cowboys (6-3, 4-2) for a Big 12 showdown. Texas Tech leads the series 25-24-3 after a 42-0 win in 2025. Oklahoma State is third in the FBS at 43.9 points per game. Texas Tech is tied for 14th (37.6).
